text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_thermal_followup_batch3","campaign_class":"routine_optimization","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before deposition"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,25,0,0,5,45,0,0,0,5],"thickness":200},"comment":"NiFeCo baseline, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":720,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard crystallization step per prior batch SOP; values carried over from validated run"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,25,0,0,5,45,0,0,0,5],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2 for overpotential"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,25,0,0,5,45,0,0,0,5],"duration":48},"comment":"routine stability check"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{},"comment":"ingest results into active learning loop"}]}
